The security-boundary documentation records the app-only trust-boundary delta, widened RISK-002, browser exposure, RISK-006, certificate deferral, least-privilege limitations, and Microsoft-only egress.

The exact test command ran 173 tests but exited nonzero with 68 errors because the read-only review sandbox denied loopback socket binding; failures were environmental PermissionError exceptions during server setup rather than observed assertions.
The exact compile command could not create __pycache__ in the read-only checkout and exited nonzero with '[Errno 1] Operation not permitted'.
The governance validator could not create its required temporary directory in this read-only environment and exited nonzero with FileNotFoundError.

The committed handoff reports successful author-side execution at this candidate: 173 tests passed, compilation exited 0, and repository validation passed. Under the review rules these author claims cannot replace independent execution.

limitations: Independent required-check evidence is incomplete: the review sandbox prohibits loopback socket binding, writes to __pycache__, and creation of temporary directories. The issue-review rules require BLOCKED whenever execution evidence is missing or failed, even when the failures appear environmental.
The non-live server walkthrough could not be independently repeated because the sandbox prohibits binding a loopback listening socket.

The checkout has grafted history, so the intermediate round-0 candidate was unavailable for a direct round-0-to-round-1 diff. The complete supplied base-to-target diff and committed round-0 report were still inspectable.
No live tenant sign-in was performed. This is intentionally excluded by the approved issue and remains a documented residual verification gap for both authentication modes.
